origin.description: Shrinks variances toward their median and correlations toward zero.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A data matrix, one observation per row.

arguments.name: lambda
arguments.text: Correlation shrinkage intensity from 0 to 1. Omitted means estimate it. In Python the name is lambda_value.

arguments.name: lambda.var
arguments.text: Variance shrinkage intensity from 0 to 1. Omitted means estimate it. In Python the name is lambda_var.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. Omitted means equal weights that sum to 1.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.text: Print both intensities, variance first. The default is true.

origin.details: The covariance is the outer product of the shrinkage standard deviations with the shrinkage correlation. Both intensities are kept on the result.
